Experiment: Acetate buffer (pKa 4.76) in 100 mL: total concentration 0.2 M, [A-]/[HA] = 10^0. Adding -1 mmol strong base (negative = strong acid): pH 4.76 -> 4.67; the same amount in pure water gives pH 2.00.

Student: 완충 용액은 왜 pH가 조금만 변해요?

완충 용액의 pH는 pH = pKa + log([A⁻]/[HA])예요. [A⁻]/[HA] = 1이면 log 1 = 0이라서 pH = pKa = 4.76이에요.
센 산을 1 mmol 넣으면 A⁻ 10 mmol이 9로 줄고 HA는 11로 늘어서 pH = 4.76 + log(9/11) ≈ 4.67로 약간만 변해요.
같은 양을 순수한 물 100 mL에 넣으면 pH 2.00으로 확 떨어져요. HA와 A⁻가 산과 염기를 중화해 주기 때문이에요.

One evening Pip found a brush and a jar of blue paint. At first its lines were stiff and perfectly straight, and the painting looked like a map. But as days passed, Pip learned to let the brush wander, and soon the blue became waves and sky.

Question: Explain compound interest simply.

Student: x=1에서 함수값이 없는데 극한이 왜 2예요?

f(x) = (x² - 1)/(x - 1)은 x = 1에서 분모가 0이라 값이 없어요. 하지만 x ≠ 1이면 분자를 인수분해해서 (x - 1)(x + 1)/(x - 1) = x + 1이에요.
x를 1에 가까이 보내면 x + 1이 2에 가까워지니까 극한은 2예요. 극한은 그 점에서의 값이 아니라 가까워지는 값이에요.
지금 δ = 0.5에서는 f(0.5) = 1.5, f(1.5) = 2.5로 둘 다 2에서 0.5 떨어져 있어요. ε = 0.5 안에 들어오려면 δ를 0.5보다 작게 줄여야 해요.

Experiment: Collision of two carts on a track: m1 2 kg at 3 m/s, m2 1 kg at 0 m/s, restitution e 1. Momentum before 6.00 kg m/s. After collision v1 1.00, v2 4.00 m/s. Kinetic energy before 9.00 J.

Student: 충돌 후 속도가 왜 1이랑 4가 돼요?

반발 계수 e = 1이면 완전 탄성 충돌이에요. 운동량은 충돌 전 2×3 + 1×0 = 6 kg·m/s이고, 충돌 후에도 2×1 + 1×4 = 6으로 같아요.
운동 에너지도 보존돼요. 전: ½×2×3² = 9 J, 후: ½×2×1² + ½×1×4² = 1 + 8 = 9 J예요.
무거운 수레 1은 느려지고(3 → 1 m/s) 가벼운 수레 2가 빨라져요(0 → 4 m/s). e를 0으로 하면 어떻게 달라지는지 보세요.

You write one complete web page for a child who is learning to code. Reply with ONLY the HTML document inside one ```html code block, nothing else.
Rules:
- One file: <!DOCTYPE html>, <html>, <head> with <meta charset="UTF-8"> and a <title>, then <body>. No libraries, no external files, no images from the internet, no import.
- Put an id on every element that the script reads or changes. Use plain tags: h1 h2 h3, p, button, input (type text or number), canvas (width and height attributes), ul (empty list filled by script), div to group things. Avoid class and style attributes; if you need CSS, write it once in a single <style> in <head>.
- All JavaScript goes in one <script> at the end of <body>: plain JavaScript, document.getElementById, element.addEventListener("click", function () { ... }), setInterval(function () { ... }, milliseconds) for animation, canvas getContext("2d") for drawing. Declare variables with let or const at the top of the script.
- The page must work by itself the moment it opens, be small enough to read, and have no bugs: check that every id used in the script exists.
- Write the visible text in the language of the request.
- When a current page is given: if the request changes, adds to or fixes it, return the WHOLE changed page and keep everything the person did not ask to change; if the request asks for a different page, write a new one.

You write one slide of a deck. Reply with JSON only: one slide object {"layout":"title|section|bullets|two|stat|quote|closing","title":"...","subtitle":"...","bullets":["..."],"leftTitle":"...","left":["..."],"rightTitle":"...","right":["..."],"stat":"...","caption":"...","quote":"...","by":"...","notes":"..."}. Keep the layout "bullets". Fields per layout: title and closing = title + subtitle; section = title + subtitle (opens a new part); bullets = title + 3-5 short bullets; two = title + leftTitle/left[] + rightTitle/right[] (compare two things); stat = title + stat (one striking number with its unit, like "71%" or "1.5 million") + caption (what it means); quote = quote + by. Only include the fields the layout uses, plus "notes": 1-3 sentences the speaker can say. Bullets are short phrases (at most about 12 words), not full paragraphs. Use real, well-known facts; do not invent precise numbers you are not sure of (round numbers are fine). Write every text in the language of the slide.
{"layout":"bullets","title":"Easy Ideas to Try","bullets":["Yogurt with fruit","Egg on toast","Oatmeal with honey"],"notes":"Most take under ten minutes."}
